# On The Block Digital

> Digital growth partner for Main Street businesses. We help local businesses get found, get chosen, and grow.

On The Block Digital is a hyper-local, outcome-driven digital marketing partner for Main Street businesses. We focus on helping restaurants, home service providers, dental practices, legal firms, and retail businesses compete with larger companies by building their online visibility in specific cities and neighborhoods.

## Industries We Serve

- Restaurants (including cafés, diners, bars, bistros, bakeries)
- Home Services (including plumbers, electricians, HVAC, contractors, landscaping)
- Dental (including dentists, orthodontists, oral surgery)
- Legal (including lawyers, law firms, attorneys)
- Retail (including shops, stores, boutiques)

## Areas We Serve

- Oakland, CA (active — Temescal, Fruitvale, Jack London Square, Rockridge, Downtown, West Oakland, East Oakland, Piedmont Ave, Lake Merritt, Chinatown)
